content:
Elaine M: Quick kickoff for Databridge integration launch week (aiming mid-Apr). Need owners for: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar logistics, inbound routing, and messaging A/B tests. Who volunteers? :wave:
Sam P: I can run webinar + production of the runbook. Thinking 45-60m: 25m live demo, 20m benchmark walkthrough, 15m Q&A. Prefer Wed or Thu evening PT.
Ben S: Ill take inbound routing + CRM hooks. Plan: webhook -> parse UTM -> route to partner queue. Will draft routing spec and test payloads.
Aria G: Ill do bench writeup. Want to compare latency/cost tradeoffs and "time to integrate" (dev-mins using our SDK). Will create reproducible notebooks for partners.
Elaine M: Launch post owner? Need a headline, quick checklist for marketplace listing, and partner quotes. Draft angle: "Integrate LLMs faster with Databridge + Redwood Inference."
Sam P: Speakers: Elaine (opening), Aria (benchmarks), me (integration demo), Databridge Eng (live Q&A). Ill set up registration page and calendar invite. Need slides by 04/07.
Ben S: Routing snippet (sketch):
```yaml
source: databridge_marketplace
priority: high
route_to: partner_inbound_queue
notify: partner@redwood.ai
```
Will also create escalations for enterprise-tier trials.
Aria G: Bench targets (initial):
- ~25-35% cost improvement with batching/caching
- p95 latency < 500ms at 1k RPS mix
Ill get synthetic and partner-supplied tests.
Elaine M: Messaging A/B variants:
A) "Ship integrations in hours — Databridge + Redwood"
B) "Production LLM performance, out of the box"
Well test blog headline + webinar subject.
Sam P: Reg fields: email, company, role, cloud provider, are you evaluating Dedicated/Private? (checkbox). Checkboxes map to routing rules.
Ben S: Will add auto-tagging for utm_campaign=databridge_launch and set SLA: reply within 1 business day for partner leads.
Aria G: Request to partner: can they share an anonymized dataset for realistic bench runs? Also sample infra config (instance types) would help reproduce results.
Elaine M: Timeline proposal:
- 04/02: first draft blog + bench outline
- 04/07: slides + reg page live
- 04/10: dry run with partner
- 04/14-04/16: launch + webinar week
Confirm EOD tomorrow?
Sam P: Confirmed. Ill spin up the reg page and share link.
Ben S: Confirmed. Will push webhook + test JSON to staging.
Aria G: Confirmed. Ill upload preliminary charts to the shared folder today.
DotBot: Automated note: registration page stub created at https://redwood.ai/webinars/databridge-stub (internal).
Elaine M: Thanks. Ill loop in Legal for logo/quote approvals and publish the partner playbook PR once drafts are in. Well reconvene here next week for status updates. :sparkles:
